# healthchecksio_check (List Resource)

Finds the checks of the project. Without a filter, it finds all checks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the checks with the tag "prod". Then, to write an import block and a resource
# block for each check, run: terraform query -generate-config-out=checks.tf
list "healthchecksio_check" "prod" {
  provider         = healthchecksio
  include_resource = true

  config {
    tags = ["prod"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `slug` (String) Find only the checks with this slug.
- `tags` (List of String) Find only the checks that have all of these tags.
